Criterion focus (paraphrased): Integrity and ethical values support the control environment
Gap: Management approved the policy/procedure, temporary owner and security@dartahara.com reporting route effective 2026-08-25. The mailbox was created, synchronized and delivery-tested. First login/monitoring, an independent deputy, HR/Legal implementation review, actual issuance, acknowledgements, training and disciplinary operation remain absent.
Required Action: Confirm monitored mailbox access; appoint an independent deputy; complete HR/Legal review; issue the controlled version; retain genuine acknowledgements and completed training.
Type II evidence requirement: Complete policy population, issue/acknowledgement timing, overdue follow-up, training results and truthful violation/zero-state review
Auditor question: Can a small management structure evidence sufficient tone and oversight, and what confidential alternate reporting mechanism is proportionate?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Independent oversight of internal control
Gap: A proportionate board-equivalent oversight design, independent-member criteria, quorum rules and cadence are documented. The charter is not approved, no independent member or internal auditor is appointed, and no quorate oversight meeting or completed management review exists.
Required Action: Approve the charter and cadence; appoint a competent independent oversight member; hold and approve the first quorate meeting; separately appoint the independent internal auditor and complete audit then management review.
Frequency: Monthly while P0 blockers remain; quarterly oversight; annual audit/review
Type II evidence requirement: Complete scheduled-meeting population, approved minutes, independent challenge, recusals, audit reports and remediation follow-up
Auditor question: Will the CPA accept the proposed pre-incorporation oversight structure, and who is sufficiently independent and competent to challenge management?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Structures, reporting lines, authority and responsibility
Gap: Legal, Finance, HR, Operations and responder roles/deputies remain unassigned.
Required Action: Issue signed appointments, reporting lines and deputies with authority and resources.
Type II evidence requirement: Role changes, delegation reviews and escalation tests
Auditor question: May temporary assignments cover the point-in-time Type I date?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Competence is attracted, developed and retained
Gap: Training is prepared but not delivered; competence and screening records are unavailable.
Required Action: Approve role competence, screening and training; complete a real cycle.
Type II evidence requirement: Screening outcome, onboarding, assessments and competence review
Auditor question: Which roles and screening are material to the system description?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Individuals are held accountable for control responsibilities
Gap: Accountability language exists but owners, sanctions and performance evidence are incomplete.
Required Action: Assign controls; approve disciplinary/corrective processes; test overdue control escalation.
Type II evidence requirement: Control-owner reviews, overdue escalations and corrective actions
Auditor question: How should accountability be demonstrated with a small staff?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Relevant, quality information supports internal control
Gap: Registers are detailed but owners, periods, verification and restricted storage are inconsistent.
Required Action: Adopt evidence metadata; validate inventories; approve restricted evidence store.
Type II evidence requirement: Evidence collection logs, source verification and integrity samples
Auditor question: Which evidence formats and retention will the CPA accept?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Security objectives and responsibilities are communicated internally
Gap: Draft policies and training content exist without delivery, acknowledgement or tested reporting routes.
Required Action: Deliver training, publish owned reporting channel and test escalation.
Type II evidence requirement: Communications, attendance, acknowledgements and reporting tests
Auditor question: Are cleaners and contractors included as system personnel?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): External parties receive relevant information
Evidence: Terms, privacy notice, support copy; HA-005
Gap: Public communications exist but legal accuracy, incident contacts and commitment-to-control mapping are not approved.
Required Action: Complete legal review and customer-commitment validation; define incident/customer communications.
Type II evidence requirement: Published versions, approvals, notices and incident communication records
Auditor question: Which external commitments enter the SOC 2 system description?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Objectives are specified clearly enough to identify risks
Evidence: Risk register; BIA; customer commitments register
Gap: Security objectives and service commitments are not formally approved; Availability objectives are proposed only.
Required Action: Approve system/service objectives, scope and RTO/RPO; link commitments to risks.
Type II evidence requirement: Objective reviews and commitment/risk traceability
Auditor question: Should Availability be included at the first Type I date?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Risks to objectives are identified and analyzed
Gap: Twenty-two risks are documented but methodology, owners and residual-risk decisions are unapproved.
Required Action: Approve methodology and owners; update for SOC 2 categories and customer commitments.
Type II evidence requirement: Quarterly risk reviews, changes and treatment evidence
Auditor question: Does the risk universe sufficiently cover service commitments?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Fraud risks are considered
Gap: No explicit fraud-risk assessment covers billing, refunds, payroll, suppliers, abuse or management override.
Required Action: Perform fraud-risk assessment and define preventive/detective controls with Finance approval.
Type II evidence requirement: Fraud review, access/SoD checks, dispute/refund monitoring
Auditor question: Which fraud risks are relevant to SOC 2 versus financial reporting?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Significant changes are identified and assessed
Gap: Software changes are traceable; organizational, supplier, legal and architecture change assessment is not consistently evidenced.
Required Action: Add security/availability/confidentiality impact gate for all material changes.
Type I Blocker: No if gate is approved before audit date
Type II evidence requirement: Change assessments and post-change validation
Auditor question: Which recent platform/supplier changes are significant for the system description?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Controls are monitored through ongoing and separate evaluations
Gap: Automated drift exists; control reviews, security-log reviews and independent audit have not operated.
Required Action: Approve monitoring calendar, start recurring reviews and complete independent audit.
Type II evidence requirement: Monitoring outputs, reviews, independent testing and exceptions
Auditor question: How much separate evaluation is required before Type I?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Deficiencies are evaluated and communicated
Gap: Corrective actions exist but exception criteria, aging, escalation and closure testing are not approved or operated.
Required Action: Approve exception workflow and demonstrate one truthful deficiency lifecycle or zero-state review.
Type II evidence requirement: Exception log, escalation, closure evidence and effectiveness tests
Auditor question: Can existing ISO corrective actions serve as SOC 2 exceptions?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Control activities mitigate risks
Evidence: Control library; ISO SoA and evidence
Gap: Technical control activities exist, but governance, HR, suppliers, availability and evidence operation remain incomplete.
Required Action: Approve unified control library, owners, frequencies and test methods.
Type II evidence requirement: Control performance by frequency and exception history
Auditor question: Is the control set complete for the final selected categories?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Technology general controls support objectives
Gap: CI and change controls are strong; live production authorization/configuration and operations evidence are incomplete.
Required Action: Run authorized production audits, live-host checks and recurring configuration review.
Type II evidence requirement: Protected runs, deployed commit, drift exports and reviews
Auditor question: Which infrastructure is operated by subservice organizations under carve-out?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Policies deploy control activities into procedures
Gap: Policies and procedures are drafts without owners, approvals, effective dates or operating records.
Required Action: Approve documents, assign owners/effective dates and start evidence collection.
Type II evidence requirement: Approvals, version history, acknowledgements and procedure records
Auditor question: May policies be approved immediately before the Type I date if controls are already implemented?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Logical access architecture protects information assets
Gap: RBAC/RLS/AAL2 are designed; production exports, factor coverage, key custody and periodic reviews are incomplete.
Required Action: Verify production authorization and MFA; complete credential and access inventories.
Type II evidence requirement: Production configs, role/factor inventories, reviews and revocations
Auditor question: What provider controls are relied on for authentication and encryption?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): New access is authorized before credentials are issued
Gap: No approved onboarding workflow or completed provisioning sample exists.
Required Action: Implement ticketed approval and retain a real joiner sample across systems.
Type II evidence requirement: Request, approval, provisioning, MFA and role verification
Auditor question: What population constitutes workforce users for sampling?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Access is modified or removed when no longer authorized
Gap: Mover/leaver, inactive-account, factor and supplier revocation evidence is absent.
Required Action: Complete first access review and retain actual mover/leaver evidence when events occur.
Type II evidence requirement: Termination timing, account/factor/session/key revocation and reviews
Auditor question: How will a no-termination period be evidenced without fabrication?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Physical access is restricted and reviewed
Gap: Customer-property access design is unverified; office/hosting physical controls rely on unknown suppliers.
Required Action: Verify smart-lock/key operation; document office boundary; collect relevant supplier assurance.
Type II evidence requirement: Issuance, access, expiry, lost key/device and leaver drills
Auditor question: Are customer properties and any office physical controls within the SOC 2 system boundary?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Access and protected information are removed when no longer needed
Gap: Fail-closed retention exists, but access revocation, asset return and approved deletion are not operating.
Required Action: Operate JML/asset return and approve retention/deletion lifecycle.
Type II evidence requirement: Revocation, returned assets, expired credentials and deletion receipts
Auditor question: Should CC6.5 testing include customer-property credentials and supplier copies?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): System boundaries prevent or detect external threats
Gap: Core TLS, private storage, authenticated scanner, signed webhooks and security headers are implemented; supplier assurance remains supporting evidence.
Required Action: Maintain evidence and complete live host/provider configuration verification.
Type I Blocker: No for design, subject to auditor verification
Type II evidence requirement: TLS/header tests, boundary scans, webhook negatives and configuration reviews
Auditor question: Are provider-operated perimeter controls carved out and adequately described?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Transmission, movement and removal of information are protected
Gap: TLS and private flows exist, but export governance, endpoint handling, international transfers and supplier deletion are incomplete.
Required Action: Approve handling/export rules and legal transfer mechanisms; test signed-download expiry.
Type II evidence requirement: Transfer approvals, export logs, secure delivery and deletion/expiry
Auditor question: Which cross-border flows and customer responsibilities must be described?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Malicious software is prevented or detected
Gap: Authenticated fail-closed scanning and CI/container scanning are implemented; recurring signature/health evidence must continue.
Required Action: Start daily scanner health and monthly clean/EICAR/image review evidence.
Type II evidence requirement: Health, signature freshness, clean/EICAR and CI/image scan records
Auditor question: Which upload paths are in scope and does every path invoke the scanner?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Configuration and vulnerability changes are detected
Gap: Repository scanning is strong; live-host, production configuration and approved vulnerability SLA evidence are missing.
Required Action: Approve severity SLAs and run recurring live/production verification.
Type II evidence requirement: Alert triage, scans, host/config drift and remediation timing
Auditor question: Are all production assets covered by the vulnerability population?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Anomalies are monitored and analyzed
Gap: Security logging works technically, but alert triage, weekly review, uptime monitoring and anomaly baselines do not operate.
Required Action: Assign owners, define thresholds and begin daily/weekly reviews.
Type II evidence requirement: Alert disposition, review logs, tuning and service anomaly records
Auditor question: What anomaly monitoring is necessary for the selected Availability scope?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Security events are evaluated for incidents
Gap: Classification model exists, but responder roster and alert-to-incident operating evidence are absent.
Required Action: Appoint responders and exercise event triage through documented disposition.
Type II evidence requirement: Event decisions, severity, escalation, false positives and incident links
Auditor question: Will a labelled tabletop satisfy initial design validation?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Incidents are contained, remediated and communicated
Gap: No completed incident or tabletop, external contacts, legal owner or emergency-change sample exists.
Required Action: Appoint roster and run prepared tabletop with communications and corrective actions.
Type II evidence requirement: Timeline, containment, communications, recovery and corrective actions
Auditor question: Which notification obligations and customer communications are in scope?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Recovery restores objectives after incidents
Gap: RTO/RPO are unapproved and no database/object restore or continuity exercise has completed.
Required Action: Approve BIA, confirm recovery entitlement and perform witnessed isolated restore/exercise.
Type II evidence requirement: Restores, integrity, RTO/RPO, service validation and lessons learned
Auditor question: What recovery evidence is necessary for Type I versus future Type II?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Infrastructure, data, software and procedures change through controlled processes
Gap: Normal GitHub release path is strong; emergency changes, live-host changes, SoD and approved procedure remain gaps.
Required Action: Approve procedure, include non-code changes and test emergency rollback/retrospective.
Type II evidence requirement: Request, approval, tests, deployment, rollback, verification and exceptions
Auditor question: Is one-person review acceptable with compensating controls at Type I?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Risk mitigation includes business disruption and other responses
Gap: Treatments and workarounds are proposed but not approved, tested or reconciled to customer commitments.
Required Action: Approve risk treatments/BIA and complete continuity exercises.
Type II evidence requirement: Treatment reviews, exercises, supplier outage records and decisions
Auditor question: Does the proposed risk response match system commitments and materiality?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Vendor and business-partner risks are assessed and managed
Gap: Supplier inventory is strong; contracts, assurance, access, incident terms, reviews and exit proof are largely absent.
Required Action: Complete critical supplier reviews and obtain CPA view on subservice treatment.
Type II evidence requirement: Due diligence, assurance review, findings, SLA/outage and exit evidence
Auditor question: Which providers are significant subservice organizations and carve-out or inclusive?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Availability commitments, objectives and monitoring are defined and operated
Gap: No uptime SLA is found, but support/scheduling promises and critical operational dependencies exist; RTO/RPO and indicators are unapproved.
Required Action: Confirm Availability scope; approve objectives and monitoring tied to actual commitments.
Type II evidence requirement: Uptime/health, job success, support/scheduling performance and reviews
Auditor question: Should Availability be in the initial examination without a platform uptime SLA?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Capacity, environmental and recovery-supporting resources meet objectives
Gap: No capacity baseline, forecast, scaling threshold or complete supplier recovery assurance was found.
Required Action: Define capacity/resource metrics and obtain supplier availability/recovery evidence.
Type II evidence requirement: Capacity trends, thresholds, scaling tests and supplier assurance
Auditor question: Which provider capacity controls are relied on under carve-out?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Recovery procedures are tested to meet availability objectives
Gap: No approved objectives, completed isolated restore, continuity exercise or achieved RTO/RPO exists.
Required Action: Approve targets and perform witnessed database/object restore plus continuity exercise.
Type II evidence requirement: Exercise plans/results, achieved targets, corrective actions and retests
Auditor question: Can one combined restore/continuity exercise address the initial design assessment?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Confidential information is identified and protected through use and disclosure
Gap: Classification inventory is populated but unapproved; supplier terms, endpoint/export handling and commitment validation are incomplete.
Required Action: Approve classification/handling and complete supplier/legal review and commitment mapping.
Type II evidence requirement: Data-flow samples, access/share/export logs, supplier reviews and incidents
Auditor question: What information is contractually designated confidential for the report?

Criterion focus (paraphrased): Confidential information is retained and disposed according to objectives
Gap: Public retention promises are not legally approved or demonstrated across database, objects, backups and suppliers; deletion is disabled.
Required Action: Obtain Legal approval and complete synthetic end-to-end deletion/legal-hold proof before real execution.
Frequency: Monthly after approval; annual schedule review
Type II evidence requirement: Approved rules, deletion receipts, holds, backup expiry and supplier propagation
Auditor question: Will the CPA accept a Type I date before production deletion is enabled if design and synthetic proof are complete?
